risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have faults (disc drive issues, overheating, HDMI/USB port problems). Photos cannot confirm operation.
risks.proof: Video clip of the PS5 turning on, reaching the home screen, and playing a game (or showing a disc being read) + quick test of at least one USB port and HDMI output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case for a used console).

risks.risk: Controller may have drift, bad buttons, or weak charging—photos can’t confirm joystick health.
risks.proof: Short screen recording showing controller test/calibration (or in-game joystick test) plus a clip of charging/charging indicator working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controller may need repair/replacement (worst case).

risks.risk: Storage size (e.g., 825GB vs other) and whether it’s original/modified is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of System Settings → Storage (and if possible System → About) showing the exact storage capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest common used configuration until storage is confirmed.

risks.risk: Missing items/cables/accessories (HDMI, power cable, stand, controller charging cable) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller cable, stand, any manuals/box).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming only the console + controller are included (worst case).

risks.risk: Model authenticity/region mismatch (disc region, console region, or swapped unit) can’t be confirmed without labels.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the console label/serial number and model number (and controller model label if available).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/uncertain until identity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Turn-on video: PS5 boots to home screen (no error), then open a game or show disc reading.
Controller test: joystick drift check + button/trigger test (video or screenshot).
System Settings screenshot showing storage capacity and system info.
Clear close-up of console serial/model label (and controller label if possible).
Photo of all included accessories laid out (HDMI, power cable, stand, controller charging cable, etc.).
response.reason: The photos suggest a PS5 Slim with a controller, but key pricing factors (working status, storage size, included accessories, and condition) are not verifiable from these images alone.
